subcommittees.name: Disability Assistance and Memorial Affairs Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans filing disability compensation claims who live in areas declared major disaster zones by the President.
dimensions.evidence: veterans who live in an area for which the President has declared a major disaster under section 401 of the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative relief through expedited claim processing, flexible evidence standards, and flexible filing deadlines.
dimensions.evidence: establishing flexible evidence requirements for veterans unable to meet the ordinary evidence requirements... and establishing a flexible filing deadline

dimensions.assessment: Directs regulatory changes within the VA without stating specific funding amounts.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall prescribe regulations setting forth criteria for priority processing of a claim for compensation

dimensions.assessment: Directs the VA Secretary to update regulations and website notices regarding disability claim prioritization categories.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall prescribe regulations setting forth criteria for priority processing of a claim for compensation

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent regulatory requirements for prioritizing claims during future declared major disasters.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall prescribe regulations setting forth criteria for priority processing

missing_information: Number of veterans expected to qualify under major disaster declarations annually
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to establish priority processing and flexible evidence/filing requirements for disability claims submitted by veterans affected by major disasters.
